hero.intro: A sourced roundup of Directive 8020 critic scores, praise and criticism — and what to know before you buy.

blocks.text: Scores below were checked on 15 November 2026. They can change as more reviews are added.

rows: 72/100 from 61 critic reviews; 5.7/10 from 335 user ratings
Turning Points praised; story and characters criticised
A harsher view of the stealth and story

blocks.text: OpenCritic and the individual outlet scores are taken from TheGamer's review roundup. The Metacritic and Game8 figures were checked directly.

items: The sci-fi horror atmosphere, with clear Alien and The Thing influences.
The cast, including Lashana Lynch as Brianna Young.
Visuals, sound design and cinematic presentation — Game8 scored both visuals and audio 9/10.
**Turning Points**, the rewind mechanic that lets you revisit decisions without replaying the whole game.
Later story beats and branching payoffs, which several reviewers found stronger than the opening.
Stealth sections that quickly become repetitive; Game Informer called the sneaking “not particularly thrilling or scary”.
Uneven pacing and an episodic structure that slows the middle of the game.
A story that over-explains its ideas and has uneven dialogue.
Characters that can feel flat; Eurogamer called the game “a touch too long” and “a little too one-note”.
Technical problems: Game8 reported visual defects and autosave failures, and called it the least optimized Dark Pictures title it had played.

blocks.text: Game8's review reported visual defects and autosave failures, and described the game as the least optimized Dark Pictures title it had played. That is one outlet's experience, not a guarantee that every platform behaves the same way. For current PC requirements and troubleshooting, see the [bug-fixes guide](/bug-fixes).

Critics are split rather than uniformly negative. If you want a cinematic sci-fi horror game with a strong cast, striking presentation and a rewind mechanic, the reviews give you reasons to try it. If repetitive stealth and uneven pacing would bother you, the same reviews give you reasons to wait for a sale. The game does not have an officially named “best” ending; the [endings guide](/all-endings) separates confirmed outcomes from unverified routes.

items: **Platforms:** PS5, Xbox Series X|S and Windows PC via Steam. No Mac version is listed.
**Storage:** Steam lists 40 GB of available space and recommends an SSD.
**Length:** HowLongToBeat community averages are about 8 hours for the main story, 10 hours for main plus extras, and 17½ hours for completionists. See the [length guide](/game-length).
**Online co-op:** added in the free 19 October 2026 update; up to five players, each needs a copy, and no crossplay has been announced. See the [multiplayer guide](/multiplayer).

**Editions:** the Digital Deluxe Edition adds outfits, additional Dark Pictures collectibles, cinematic filters, a digital artbook and a soundtrack; the Steam upgrade requires the base game. See the [buying guide](/directive-8020-buy).

blocks.text: This page summarises published reviews; it is not a first-hand review. The scores and quotes above were checked on 15 November 2026. Follow the source links below for the original articles.
